name: HiveEO — AI Search Visibility Suite
author: Clifford Williams

sections.description:
HiveEO is an Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) toolkit for WordPress. It doesn’t just optimise your content for AI search — it generates it, publishes it, tracks whether AI is actually citing you, and builds authority through real distribution. Get your business, products, and services cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, and Claude.

Also called Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AIO, or AI SEO — different names for the same shift: search results are being replaced by a single AI-written answer, and the only question that matters now is whether your business is the source that answer is built from.

Two ways in: click HiveEO in your WordPress admin sidebar — it’s there the moment you activate the plugin, no setup step needed to see it. Or add [hiveeo] to any page if you’d rather it live on the front end. Either way the full tool renders immediately. One real step still required before anything AI-powered works: paste a free Gemini API key into Settings (takes under a minute, no billing needed) — the interface itself needs no configuration, but generation, comments, and probing all need that key first.

🚨 Why this matters right now: AI Overviews already appear on roughly half of all Google searches, and organic click-through collapses hard the moment one shows up on a query — unless your page is the one being cited, in which case cited pages see meaningfully more clicks than before. The pages winning that citation are increasingly not the ones ranking #1. A large share of AI Overview citations now come from pages outside the top 5 organic results entirely. Traditional domain authority barely correlates with getting cited anymore. What does correlate: clean structured data, direct-answer content formatted for extraction, real author expertise signals, and topical depth across a whole content cluster — not one lucky blog post.

📊 What Google and AI search engines actually demand in 2026 — and how HiveEO addresses each one:

  • Structured data / schema markup. The large majority of pages cited by Google’s AI Mode and by ChatGPT carry structured data. → HiveEO’s Schema Builder auto-injects Organisation, Product, and FAQ schema into your site’s <head> — no copy/paste, no separate plugin.
  • Extractable, front-loaded answers. AI systems retrieve short, self-contained passages — a direct answer in the first sentence or two of a section, not three paragraphs of preamble first. → HiveEO’s Create tab writes to AEO rules by default: direct-answer leads, FAQ sections, question-phrased subheadings.
  • E-E-A-T and named author expertise. AI Overview citations skew overwhelmingly toward sources with clear expertise and trust signals — this became a stricter filter through 2026, not a looser one. → HiveEO’s Entity Strength score and Infrastructure panel are built around exactly this signal.
  • Topical authority via content clusters, not isolated posts. → This is what AutoPilot’s Pillar/Cluster pipeline is for — building out a full topic, not one article.
  • Multi-format presence. Content combining text, structured data, and video sees a substantially higher citation rate than text alone. → HiveEO’s NotebookLM Studio and YouTube distribution exist specifically because video is currently the fastest-growing single source AI engines cite from.
  • Genuine off-site authority signals (Reddit is currently the single most-cited domain across every major AI engine). → HiveEO’s Threads tab and Growth Nexus outreach exist for exactly this reason — AEO isn’t just an on-page problem.
  • llms.txt — included, honestly framed. HiveEO generates and auto-updates yours. To be straight with you: Google has said on the record it doesn’t use llms.txt for Search or AI Overviews, and no major AI provider has officially confirmed reading it at inference time either. Perplexity and Claude show more retrieval interest in it than the others. It costs you nothing to have, it’s part of the emerging agent-readiness stack, and we’re not going to pretend it’s a bigger lever than it currently is.

✅ What You Get For Free (WP.org):

✅ AEO Checklist — Setup, Entity, and Presence categories, a real action plan not just a score
✅ Schema Builder — Organisation, Product, and FAQ schema, auto-injected into your site’s <head>
✅ Create (Gemini BYOK) — AI blog post generator and repurposer, AEO writing rules, A/B headline/hook variants, social copy for LinkedIn/Facebook/Instagram/Pinterest/X, Article + DefinedTerm schema
✅ Community Comment Generator (Gemini BYOK) — unlimited; no other AEO plugin in this category has one
✅ Thread Creator (Gemini BYOK) — unlimited
✅ AI Visibility Tracker (BYOK) — probe ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini directly, see whether you’re actually being cited
✅ Infrastructure Panel — llms.txt editor (auto-updating), AI bot allowlist, crawler log, entity strength score
✅ Action Guide — Module 1, 4 lessons, built on our EPPM framework
✅ Dashboard — real progress metrics, not a static score

⚡ Additional features at haiv3.com/hiveeo:

⚡ AutoPilot — fully automated Pillar/Cluster content pipeline: citation-gap discovery → generation → publish → social distribution, on a schedule
⚡ Growth Nexus — outreach CRM: AI Prospector, Outreach & Backlinks, Network Analytics
⚡ GA4 Analytics Chat — ask questions about your real traffic data, grounded in a live report, with real charts
⚡ Confirmed AI Citations — cross-references real AI-referred traffic against what you’re actually being cited for
⚡ Multi-platform social distribution — YouTube, TikTok, Binance Square, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Telegram, X
⚡ NotebookLM Studio — multi-format audio/video generation from your content
⚡ Podcast Feed — automatic RSS feed built from your generated audio content
⚡ Compiled eBooks with marketplace reference links
⚡ Distribution Status — one unified view across every publishing channel
⚡ Intent Match & Voice of AI — query-intent classification and per-engine sentiment tracking
⚡ Google Search Console integration — real opportunities feeding straight into your citation gap bank
⚡ Brand Defence comment mode — get ahead of misinformation before AI cites it
⚡ Reverse Discovery — find out who AI is citing in your space instead of you
⚡ URL scraper and AI product description generator
⚡ Sitemap batch importer
⚡ Full 13-category AEO checklist with per-engine strategies
⚡ Action Guide — all 18 lessons (Modules 2–4)
⚡ Agency white-label and multi-client dashboard

💪 Why HiveEO is different from a typical AEO plugin: most AEO tools score your existing content and stop there — you still have to go write the fix yourself. HiveEO generates the content, publishes it, distributes it across social and video, and then tells you whether any of it actually got cited. Optimisation, generation, and distribution in one place instead of three separate tools.

👤 Who this is for: professionals, consultants, founders, and businesses who want to be the source AI chooses to reference — not just another page Google ranks.

Bring Your Own API Key (BYOK)

HiveEO uses your own API keys (Gemini, OpenAI, Perplexity). Keys are stored in your WordPress database. AI generation requests are sent directly from your server to your chosen AI provider — there is no relay or intermediary server.

Get a free Gemini key at aistudio.google.com — no billing required.

Privacy

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

1. Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com)
Used to generate community comments, seed threads, AI product descriptions, blog posts and social copy in the Create tab, and visibility probe responses. Requests are made only when you click a generate button — never automatically. Your Gemini API key is sent directly from your WordPress server to Google. Data sent includes your prompt text (business context, product details, thread content, and — for the Create tab — your topic, tone, or pasted/fetched content to repurpose). See Google’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

2. OpenAI API (api.openai.com)
Used optionally in the Visibility Tracker to probe ChatGPT responses, and optionally as an alternate generation provider in the Create tab. Only used if you add an OpenAI API key in Settings. See OpenAI’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

3. Perplexity API (api.perplexity.ai)
Used optionally in the Visibility Tracker to probe Perplexity responses. Only used if you add a Perplexity API key in Settings. See Perplexity’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

4. Reddit API (reddit.com)
Used in the Threads tab to fetch live trending threads from relevant subreddits. Requests are made only when you click “Refresh live threads” — never automatically. No personal data is sent. Data received includes public post titles, scores, and URLs. See Reddit’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

5. Hacker News API (hacker-news.firebaseio.com)
Used in the Threads tab to fetch live trending Hacker News stories. Requests are made only when you click “Refresh live threads” — never automatically. No personal data is sent. Data received includes public story titles, scores, and URLs. See Y Combinator’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

6. User-provided URLs (Create tab)
When generating or repurposing content, HiveEO fetches the page content of any URL you enter in the “Reference link” field, any URL used for “Repurpose from URL”, and any URL mentioned in the “What is this entity?” description (e.g. “see HEX.com”). This is requested only when you click a generate button. The fetched text is included in the prompt sent to your chosen AI provider (Gemini or OpenAI) as factual reference material — it is not stored or sent anywhere else. No data is sent to any third party other than the site whose URL you entered (a normal page request) and your chosen AI provider.

Local Data Storage

AI Bot Visit Log
The plugin optionally logs visits from known AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) to your site. This data is stored entirely within your own WordPress database — no data is sent to any external service. Each log entry stores: the bot name, the URL visited, the timestamp, and a 12-character hash of the visitor IP address (derived using your site’s WordPress salt — the original IP is never stored). This log is used only to display AI crawler activity in the Infrastructure panel.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following open-source libraries locally (no CDN):

  • Alpine.js v3.15.12 — MIT License. Source: https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine
  • Tailwind CSS v3.4.19 — MIT License. Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
  • Tabler Icons v2.47.0 — MIT License. Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/hiveeo/ or install via the WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Click HiveEO in your WordPress admin sidebar — the full tool is already there, no page needed. (Prefer it on a public page instead? Create a WordPress page, add [hiveeo] to the content, and publish — same tool, either location.)
  4. Go to the Settings tab, paste your free Gemini API key
  5. Start with the AEO Checklist to set up your business entity
sections.faq:
Do I need to pay for the AI features?

No. HiveEO uses your own free Gemini API key (Google AI Studio). The free tier of Gemini 2.5 Flash has no billing requirement and is sufficient for all core features.

Does HiveEO store my API keys on its servers?

Your API keys are stored in your WordPress database. They are sent directly from your server to the respective AI provider (Google, OpenAI, Perplexity) — never to haiv3.com.

What is AEO?

Answer Engine Optimisation is the practice of structuring your online presence so that AI assistants like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini recommend and cite your business when users ask relevant questions.

Will this affect my existing SEO?

No. HiveEO adds structured data (JSON-LD schema) to your site’s <head> which is additive — it enhances your existing SEO signals without removing or overriding anything.

What WordPress version is required?

WordPress 6.0 or higher. PHP 7.4 or higher.

Is this plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes. HiveEO includes specific compatibility code for Hummingbird Pro to prevent schema tags from being delayed or minified. Other caching plugins should work without configuration.

short_description: Get your business cited in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude. Schema auto-inject, AEO checklist, comment generator, and AI visibility tracking.
description:
HiveEO is an Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO) toolkit for WordPress. It doesn’t just optimise your content for AI search — it generates it, publishes it, tracks whether AI is actually citing you, and builds authority through real distribution. Get your business, products, and services cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google Gemini, and Claude.

Also called Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AIO, or AI SEO — different names for the same shift: search results are being replaced by a single AI-written answer, and the only question that matters now is whether your business is the source that answer is built from.

Two ways in: click HiveEO in your WordPress admin sidebar — it’s there the moment you activate the plugin, no setup step needed to see it. Or add [hiveeo] to any page if you’d rather it live on the front end. Either way the full tool renders immediately. One real step still required before anything AI-powered works: paste a free Gemini API key into Settings (takes under a minute, no billing needed) — the interface itself needs no configuration, but generation, comments, and probing all need that key first.

🚨 Why this matters right now: AI Overviews already appear on roughly half of all Google searches, and organic click-through collapses hard the moment one shows up on a query — unless your page is the one being cited, in which case cited pages see meaningfully more clicks than before. The pages winning that citation are increasingly not the ones ranking #1. A large share of AI Overview citations now come from pages outside the top 5 organic results entirely. Traditional domain authority barely correlates with getting cited anymore. What does correlate: clean structured data, direct-answer content formatted for extraction, real author expertise signals, and topical depth across a whole content cluster — not one lucky blog post.

📊 What Google and AI search engines actually demand in 2026 — and how HiveEO addresses each one:

  • Structured data / schema markup. The large majority of pages cited by Google’s AI Mode and by ChatGPT carry structured data. → HiveEO’s Schema Builder auto-injects Organisation, Product, and FAQ schema into your site’s <head> — no copy/paste, no separate plugin.
  • Extractable, front-loaded answers. AI systems retrieve short, self-contained passages — a direct answer in the first sentence or two of a section, not three paragraphs of preamble first. → HiveEO’s Create tab writes to AEO rules by default: direct-answer leads, FAQ sections, question-phrased subheadings.
  • E-E-A-T and named author expertise. AI Overview citations skew overwhelmingly toward sources with clear expertise and trust signals — this became a stricter filter through 2026, not a looser one. → HiveEO’s Entity Strength score and Infrastructure panel are built around exactly this signal.
  • Topical authority via content clusters, not isolated posts. → This is what AutoPilot’s Pillar/Cluster pipeline is for — building out a full topic, not one article.
  • Multi-format presence. Content combining text, structured data, and video sees a substantially higher citation rate than text alone. → HiveEO’s NotebookLM Studio and YouTube distribution exist specifically because video is currently the fastest-growing single source AI engines cite from.
  • Genuine off-site authority signals (Reddit is currently the single most-cited domain across every major AI engine). → HiveEO’s Threads tab and Growth Nexus outreach exist for exactly this reason — AEO isn’t just an on-page problem.
  • llms.txt — included, honestly framed. HiveEO generates and auto-updates yours. To be straight with you: Google has said on the record it doesn’t use llms.txt for Search or AI Overviews, and no major AI provider has officially confirmed reading it at inference time either. Perplexity and Claude show more retrieval interest in it than the others. It costs you nothing to have, it’s part of the emerging agent-readiness stack, and we’re not going to pretend it’s a bigger lever than it currently is.

✅ What You Get For Free (WP.org):

✅ AEO Checklist — Setup, Entity, and Presence categories, a real action plan not just a score
✅ Schema Builder — Organisation, Product, and FAQ schema, auto-injected into your site’s <head>
✅ Create (Gemini BYOK) — AI blog post generator and repurposer, AEO writing rules, A/B headline/hook variants, social copy for LinkedIn/Facebook/Instagram/Pinterest/X, Article + DefinedTerm schema
✅ Community Comment Generator (Gemini BYOK) — unlimited; no other AEO plugin in this category has one
✅ Thread Creator (Gemini BYOK) — unlimited
✅ AI Visibility Tracker (BYOK) — probe ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini directly, see whether you’re actually being cited
✅ Infrastructure Panel — llms.txt editor (auto-updating), AI bot allowlist, crawler log, entity strength score
✅ Action Guide — Module 1, 4 lessons, built on our EPPM framework
✅ Dashboard — real progress metrics, not a static score

⚡ Additional features at haiv3.com/hiveeo:

⚡ AutoPilot — fully automated Pillar/Cluster content pipeline: citation-gap discovery → generation → publish → social distribution, on a schedule
⚡ Growth Nexus — outreach CRM: AI Prospector, Outreach & Backlinks, Network Analytics
⚡ GA4 Analytics Chat — ask questions about your real traffic data, grounded in a live report, with real charts
⚡ Confirmed AI Citations — cross-references real AI-referred traffic against what you’re actually being cited for
⚡ Multi-platform social distribution — YouTube, TikTok, Binance Square, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, Telegram, X
⚡ NotebookLM Studio — multi-format audio/video generation from your content
⚡ Podcast Feed — automatic RSS feed built from your generated audio content
⚡ Compiled eBooks with marketplace reference links
⚡ Distribution Status — one unified view across every publishing channel
⚡ Intent Match & Voice of AI — query-intent classification and per-engine sentiment tracking
⚡ Google Search Console integration — real opportunities feeding straight into your citation gap bank
⚡ Brand Defence comment mode — get ahead of misinformation before AI cites it
⚡ Reverse Discovery — find out who AI is citing in your space instead of you
⚡ URL scraper and AI product description generator
⚡ Sitemap batch importer
⚡ Full 13-category AEO checklist with per-engine strategies
⚡ Action Guide — all 18 lessons (Modules 2–4)
⚡ Agency white-label and multi-client dashboard

💪 Why HiveEO is different from a typical AEO plugin: most AEO tools score your existing content and stop there — you still have to go write the fix yourself. HiveEO generates the content, publishes it, distributes it across social and video, and then tells you whether any of it actually got cited. Optimisation, generation, and distribution in one place instead of three separate tools.

👤 Who this is for: professionals, consultants, founders, and businesses who want to be the source AI chooses to reference — not just another page Google ranks.

Bring Your Own API Key (BYOK)

HiveEO uses your own API keys (Gemini, OpenAI, Perplexity). Keys are stored in your WordPress database. AI generation requests are sent directly from your server to your chosen AI provider — there is no relay or intermediary server.

Get a free Gemini key at aistudio.google.com — no billing required.

Privacy

External Services

This plugin connects to the following external services:

1. Google Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com)
Used to generate community comments, seed threads, AI product descriptions, blog posts and social copy in the Create tab, and visibility probe responses. Requests are made only when you click a generate button — never automatically. Your Gemini API key is sent directly from your WordPress server to Google. Data sent includes your prompt text (business context, product details, thread content, and — for the Create tab — your topic, tone, or pasted/fetched content to repurpose). See Google’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

2. OpenAI API (api.openai.com)
Used optionally in the Visibility Tracker to probe ChatGPT responses, and optionally as an alternate generation provider in the Create tab. Only used if you add an OpenAI API key in Settings. See OpenAI’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

3. Perplexity API (api.perplexity.ai)
Used optionally in the Visibility Tracker to probe Perplexity responses. Only used if you add a Perplexity API key in Settings. See Perplexity’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

4. Reddit API (reddit.com)
Used in the Threads tab to fetch live trending threads from relevant subreddits. Requests are made only when you click “Refresh live threads” — never automatically. No personal data is sent. Data received includes public post titles, scores, and URLs. See Reddit’s Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

5. Hacker News API (hacker-news.firebaseio.com)
Used in the Threads tab to fetch live trending Hacker News stories. Requests are made only when you click “Refresh live threads” — never automatically. No personal data is sent. Data received includes public story titles, scores, and URLs. See Y Combinator’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

6. User-provided URLs (Create tab)
When generating or repurposing content, HiveEO fetches the page content of any URL you enter in the “Reference link” field, any URL used for “Repurpose from URL”, and any URL mentioned in the “What is this entity?” description (e.g. “see HEX.com”). This is requested only when you click a generate button. The fetched text is included in the prompt sent to your chosen AI provider (Gemini or OpenAI) as factual reference material — it is not stored or sent anywhere else. No data is sent to any third party other than the site whose URL you entered (a normal page request) and your chosen AI provider.

Local Data Storage

AI Bot Visit Log
The plugin optionally logs visits from known AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, etc.) to your site. This data is stored entirely within your own WordPress database — no data is sent to any external service. Each log entry stores: the bot name, the URL visited, the timestamp, and a 12-character hash of the visitor IP address (derived using your site’s WordPress salt — the original IP is never stored). This log is used only to display AI crawler activity in the Infrastructure panel.

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles the following open-source libraries locally (no CDN):

  • Alpine.js v3.15.12 — MIT License. Source: https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine
  • Tailwind CSS v3.4.19 — MIT License. Source: https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss
  • Tabler Icons v2.47.0 — MIT License. Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons
